post.caption: Harry Winston's first emerald cost 25 cents. At age 12, in 1908, he spotted a green stone in a pawnshop tray of cheap costume jewelry. The owner thought it was glass, but it was a two carat emerald. He paid 25 cents, buying a second stone to draw less attention. Two days later he sold the emerald for 800 dollars. At 15 he sold gems to oil prospectors in Los Angeles saloons. At his first bank meeting a banker took him for a messenger, so he hired a distinguished older man to front his meetings. He founded the house of Harry Winston in 1932.
